title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.13287v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) achieve high decoding efficiency through block-parallel, arbitrary-order generation, making them attractive for latency-sensitive applications. GUI agents represent a natural testbed for this paradigm, as they must repeatedly perceive screen states and emit structured, spatially grounded actions in real time. However, whether dLLMs can be extended into capable multimodal GUI agents while preserving their parallel decoding advantage remains an open question. We present LLaDA-UI, a 16.7B-parameter MoE-based, block-wise diffusion vision-language GUI agent. LLaDA-UI follows a two-stage training pipeline: general multimodal pre-training aligns a native-resolution vision encoder with the LLaDA2.0-mini-base diffusion language backbone, followed by GUI-agent supervised fine-tuning on diverse mobile, desktop, web, and grounding data. translated_title: LLaDA-UI：将块级扩散引入视觉语言GUI智能体
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型通过块并行、任意顺序的生成方式实现了高解码效率，这使其在对延迟敏感的应用中极具吸引力。GUI智能体是这一范式的天然试验场，因为它们必须实时地反复感知屏幕状态并发出结构化、具有空间定位信息的动作。然而，扩散大语言模型能否在保持其并行解码优势的同时，扩展为能力强大的多模态GUI智能体，仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出了LLaDA-UI，一个拥有167亿参数、基于混合专家架构的块级扩散视觉语言GUI智能体。LLaDA-UI遵循两阶段训练流程：第一阶段通过通用多模态预训练，将原生分辨率的视觉编码器与LLaDA2.0-mini-base扩散语言骨干网络进行对齐；随后在多样化的移动端、桌面端、网页及视觉定位数据上进行GUI智能体监督微调。在广泛采用的视觉定位基准和导航基准上……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出LLaDA-UI——一个基于MoE架构的167亿参数块级扩散视觉语言GUI智能体，通过两阶段训练证明扩散大语言模型能够在保持并行解码效率优势的同时，成为强大的多模态GUI操作智能体。
